answer: The spiral counter is kept in cipher and violet publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2607 identities would post 2651 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
